$comment: Curated CC0 sources. 'scope' = 'whole-library' when every item at the source is CC0; 'filter-only' when the source mixes licenses and only items carrying a CC0 label qualify. 'searchable' = this repo's MCP server can search it directly. 'verified' = date and evidence this entry was last checked against the source's own license page or API. 'pending' = candidates not yet verified; they are neither recommended nor known to be non-CC0.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.notes: API requires a User-Agent naming your app and a 'Powered by Poly Haven' credit when showing live API content. Downloaded assets need no attribution.

verified.evidence: license page meta: 'CC0 means absolute freedom.'; polyhaven.com/llms.txt: 'every asset is CC0'

sources.name: Openverse
sources.notes: Meta-search over Flickr, Freesound, Wikimedia Commons, museums and more. Only items whose own license field is 'cc0' qualify. Public Domain Mark ('pdm') items are excluded.

verified.evidence: API item field license="cc0" with license_url creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.notes: PBR materials, HDRIs and models. Searchable through the v3 API (ambientcg.com/api/v3/assets). The API sends no CORS headers, so browsers cannot call it directly.

verified.evidence: docs.ambientcg.com/license links CC0 1.0 for all assets

sources.name: Kenney
sources.notes: 2D/3D game asset packs, UI kits and sound effects. CC0 covers the assets on the asset pages.

verified.evidence: kenney.nl/support: 'the asset pages are public domain licensed (CC0)'

sources.name: Freesound (CC0 filter)
sources.notes: Mixed licenses. Use the 'Creative Commons 0' license filter. Many CC0 Freesound items are also reachable through Openverse search.

verified.evidence: Openverse returns freesound items with license="cc0"

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons — Category:CC-Zero
sources.notes: Mixed licenses across Commons. Files in this category carry a CC0 tag; check each file page.

sources.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access
sources.notes: Open Access API without a key. Only items whose share_license_status is "CC0" qualify; the collection also holds copyrighted works.

verified.evidence: open-access page links creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/; API items carry share_license_status="CC0"

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
sources.notes: Collection API without a key. Only objects with isPublicDomain=true qualify. The v1 search endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01; this repo uses v1.1.

verified.evidence: metmuseum/openaccess README: artworks covered by the Open Access policy are identified with the Creative Commons Zero (CC0) icon; metmuseum.github.io: datasets waived under CC0
quaternius.com/faq.html: models are licensed under CC0

sources.name: KayKit (Kay Lousberg)
sources.notes: Low-poly 3D game asset packs on itch.io. Free packs checked are CC0; check the license row on each pack page.

verified.evidence: KayKit Adventurers itch.io page license row: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal
site metadata: 'ShareTextures Free CC0 Textures & Models'
about page: textures are licensed as CC0 (links creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)

sources.name: Openclipart
sources.notes: Vector clip art (SVG). Its JSON search endpoint returned HTML on the verification date, so it is not searchable here.

verified.evidence: openclipart.org/share: 'we use the Creative Commons Zero license'

sources.name: OpenGameArt (CC0 filter)
sources.notes: Mixed licenses (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, GPL, CC0). Filter by the CC0 license and check each entry.

verified.evidence: FAQ describes uploading content as CC0; CC0 is one of the site's license filters

excluded.name: Unsplash
excluded.reason: Uses the Unsplash License, not CC0.

excluded.name: Pixabay
excluded.reason: Uses the Pixabay Content License, not CC0.

excluded.name: Pexels
excluded.reason: Uses the Pexels License, not CC0.

excluded.name: SMK (National Gallery of Denmark)
excluded.reason: Its API marks public-domain works with the Public Domain Mark (PDM), not CC0.

pending.name: National Gallery of Art (US)
pending.reason: Metadata repo (github.com/NationalGalleryOfArt/opendata) is CC0. The image policy page returned HTTP 403, so image licensing is unverified.

pending.name: Rijksmuseum
pending.reason: Object records link both the Public Domain Mark and CC0; which one covers the images is unverified.

pending.name: Smithsonian Open Access
pending.reason: API needs an api.data.gov key; per-item CC0 fields could not be checked without one.

pending.name: Art Institute of Chicago
pending.reason: Site and API returned a bot challenge (HTTP 403) on the verification date.
